name: dutchpoint
description: DutchPoint: A Decentralized Dutch Auction Platform - launches the Gavora (GVRA) token

scripts.slither: slither contracts/DutchAuction.sol --config-file slither.config.json --fail-medium && slither contracts/GavoraToken.sol --config-file slither.config.json --fail-medium
scripts.deploy:local: mkdir -p .hardhat-home && HOME=$PWD/.hardhat-home hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network localhost
scripts.deploy:sepolia: mkdir -p .hardhat-home && HOME=$PWD/.hardhat-home hardhat run scripts/deploy.ts --network sepolia
scripts.time:advance: mkdir -p .hardhat-home && HOME=$PWD/.hardhat-home hardhat run scripts/advance-time.ts --network localhost
scripts.seed:local: mkdir -p .hardhat-home && HOME=$PWD/.hardhat-home hardhat run scripts/seed-local.ts --network localhost
scripts.check: npm run compile && npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run build
